event: BEI's delisting of 18 issuers takes effect on 10 November 2026: 7 bankrupt companies (incl. Sritex/SRIL, TELE, COWL, MTRA, TOYS, SBAT, TDPM) and 11 suspended for more than 50 months (incl. SUGI, GOLL, DUCK), after a buyback window that ran to 9 November. (update of E0653)
key_numbers: 18 issuers · 7 bankrupt + 11 suspended >50 months · buyback period 11 May-9 Nov 2026 · effective 10 Nov 2026

event: Golkar figures (Secretary-General Sarmuji, Fraksi Golkar's Doli Kurnia) say the DPR can use its right to express an opinion (hak menyatakan pendapat) over VP Gibran after the Supreme Court (MA) ruling that his SMA-equivalence certificate was invalid; Deputy Speaker Dasco says it will be processed formally after recess. (update of E0466)
key_numbers: Proposal needs at least 25 DPR members · adoption needs plenary with at least two-thirds of members attending · basis Art. 20A(2) UUD 1945 and Art. 79 UU MD3 17/2014 · DPR sessions resume 10 Nov 2026 · MA ruling dated about 30 Oct 2026

event: PSI chair Kaesang Pangarep announced that Secretary-General Raja Juli Antoni, Deputy Chair Isyana Bagoes Oka and Dewan Pembina member Giring Ganesha resigned from the party, saying service to the state ranks above party interests.
key_numbers: 3 resignations · announced 9 Nov 2026 21:31 WIB

event: Home Affairs Minister Tito Karnavian denied reports that he was barred from travelling abroad in connection with the wiretapping case, calling many rumours hoaxes and saying he has had no role in Polri matters since retiring in 2019. (update of E0562)
key_numbers: Retired from Polri 2019 · rumour address Widya Chandra 4 vs actual Widya Chandra 1

event: Menko Polkam Dudung Abdurachman said wiretapping is only allowed within a criminal investigation and not against a head of state; he joked that about 6,000 people were on the target list, including him. (update of E0562)
key_numbers: About 6,000 names on the alleged list (stated by Dudung, unverified) · 4 suspects, 3 detained at Mako Brimob, Irjen Slamet Uliandi not detained due to illness

event: PDI-P chair Megawati Soekarnoputri said in a national address that she had asked for Listyo Sigit to be replaced as Kapolri and that she was among those wiretapped; no verification was given. (update of E0562)
key_numbers: Statement 9 Nov 2026 · claim unverified

event: At the Aksi Rakyat Bela Indonesia rally in Jakarta, figures including Bachtiar Nasir, Jimly Asshiddiqie and Said Didu presented five demands tied to the alleged wiretapping, including enforcing court rulings and Art. 33 UUD 1945; a bigger action is planned. (update of E0562)
key_numbers: 5 demands · next action Sunday 15 Nov 2026 (Hari Pahlawan) · no crowd figure reported

event: President Prabowo ordered accelerated river normalisation in Aceh, North Sumatra and West Sumatra after follow-up floods, in a limited meeting at Istana Merdeka.
key_numbers: 137 rivers (31 Aceh, 48 North Sumatra, 58 West Sumatra) · 38 river mouths: 7 done, 11 in progress, 20 not yet · 41 follow-up floods Apr-Oct 2026 · 12 districts hit per BNPB

event: Kejagung has begun examining alleged links between Listyo Sigit and nickel miner Arif Kurniawan in an illegal mining case, per Suara.com. (update of E0562)
key_numbers: Single-source report

event: KPK summoned Gerindra DPR member Anwar Sadad over the East Java hibah (grant) corruption case, but he did not appear, citing DPR recess.
key_numbers: Summons 9 Nov 2026 · absent

event: Komdigi said GitHub was inaccessible in Indonesia for about four hours after it blocked IP addresses, requested by a government agency over suspected malware attacks, that GitHub also used; the addresses were then removed from the block list.
key_numbers: About 4 hours of outage · statement published 9 Nov 2026 · access back to normal

event: Nvidia's board launched an independent-director investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he confirmed an extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, a woman US media allege worked for Chinese intelligence; he remains CEO.
key_numbers: Nvidia lost US$450 billion market value in one day last week, regained 4% on Friday · Alice Huang's employer Megaspeed reportedly bought about US$4.8 billion of Nvidia equipment · House Republicans asked Huang to testify 18 Nov · NYT first reported 29 Oct

event: CNBC Indonesia reported, citing Counterpoint and Omdia, that global smartphone shipments fell about 20% and tablet shipments 23% year on year in Q3 2026, blamed on memory-chip shortages and weak demand. (update of E0504)
key_numbers: Smartphones -20% YoY, lowest Q3 since 2012 (Counterpoint) · tablets -23% YoY to about 32 million units (Omdia) · Apple tablets -28%, share 36% · Lenovo +12% · Omdia expects no significant tablet recovery before 2028

event: Komdigi warned buyers of Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta smart glasses, which go on sale in Indonesia on 11 November, to follow the Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) when recording other people. (update of E0616)
key_numbers: On sale 11 Nov 2026 · prices from about Rp8 million (Rp8.79 million cited by one outlet) · UU PDP No. 27/2022 · models: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3, Oakley Meta HSTN and Vanguard

event: Bisnis Market reported data-centre projects are being halted or opposed across Southeast Asia, including BDX in Jatiluhur (no AMDAL or PBG) and water-shortage protests in Nongsa, Batam, as Thailand paused 49 projects. (update of E0584)
key_numbers: Thailand: 49 projects halted and 117 more approvals suspended (Sept 2026) · BDX Jatiluhur, West Java halted for missing AMDAL/PBG · Nongsa, Batam water-shortage protests · Johor, Malaysia protest at ZData

event: CNBC Indonesia, citing blockchain investigator ZachXBT, reported the Credit Mutuel Arkea hack may have cost about US$133 million, which the bank has not confirmed; it says client assets were unaffected and some funds are frozen. (update of E0667)
key_numbers: About US$133 million (about Rp2.4 trillion, unconfirmed) · about US$30 million stolen by 3 Nov per ZachXBT · bank disclosed 4 Nov · earlier Katadata figure: over EUR100 million

event: The Indonesian Ulema Council (MUI) issued Fatwa No. 131 of 2026 declaring vaping (e-cigarettes) haram, covering use, production and trade, and urged the government and DPR to draft a ban law.
key_numbers: Fatwa Komisi Fatwa MUI No. 131 Tahun 2026 · dated 6 Nov 2026, reported 9 Nov

event: Forestry Minister Raja Juli Antoni resigned as PSI secretary-general and from party activities, following Giring Ganesha, saying he wants to focus on Prabowo's forestry directives; Kaesang also acknowledged Giring, Isyana and Raja Juli leaving.
key_numbers: 3 senior PSI figures gone (Giring, Isyana, Raja Juli) · announced 9 Nov 2026 ~18:54 WIB

event: Liputan6 fact-check rated as a hoax a Facebook photo claiming ex-President Jokowi was handcuffed over the Listyo Sigit wiretapping case; the image was edited from a YouTube thumbnail.
key_numbers: Posted 8 Nov 2026 · source video dated 5 Nov 2026 · Bareskrim has named 4 suspects (case does not involve Jokowi)

event: BNPB reported 782 karhutla hotspots across provinces with 1,534 ha being handled, with Central Kalimantan the highest at 359 hotspots (up 49%). (update of E0648)
key_numbers: 782 hotspots · 1,534 ha · Kalteng 359 hotspots +49%, 755 ha · Papua Selatan 142 hotspots -4%, 257 ha · Kaltim 93 hotspots -22% · 43 air assets in 10 provinces (as of 8 Nov)

event: Prabowo is set to present national hero titles on Heroes' Day, with the Social Affairs Minister saying his grandfather Margono Djojohadikusumo is among those proposed.
key_numbers: 10 Nov 2026 (not a public holiday) · more than 10 names proposed (an 18 figure unconfirmed) · Margono Djojohadikusumo named

event: Several groups plan a demonstration in front of the DPR/MPR building in Jakarta on 10 November, and police urged motorists to avoid the area; demands were not stated in the sources read.
key_numbers: 10 Nov 2026 · DPR recess ends 9/10 Nov · parking set at GBK · personnel numbers not yet disclosed

event: BMKG issued an early warning for coastal tidal flooding (banjir rob) covering 2-17 November 2026, alongside heavy rain and high-wave warnings for 9 November.
key_numbers: Warning window 2-17 Nov 2026 (details not read)
